_description: Lifeline — FCC program providing $9.25/month discount on phone or internet. Eligibility calculated by PolicyEngine.
name: Lifeline
description: Provides a monthly discount on phone or internet service. Eligible households get up to $9.25/month off their bill, or up to $34.25 on Tribal lands.
documents_needed: Proof of income OR proof of enrollment in qualifying program

application.notes: Apply through the National Verifier at nv.fcc.gov/lifeline — same process for all states.
